title: Park Irrigation from Drained Pools
summary:
*   City leaders approved a resolution to develop a water reuse program.
*   The program aims to redirect water drained from swimming pools.
*   This recycled water will be used for immediately irrigating trees and grass in city parks.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
JULY 25,1996
1. Approve a resolution to direct the City Manager to develop a plan to use the drained
water from the fill & draw pools for watering trees and grass on City parkland and
implement immediately.
(Councilmember Ronney Reynolds and Councilmember Eric Mitchell) Approved on Councilmember
Griffith's motion, Councilmember Reynolds' second, 5-0 vote, Mayor
Todd and Councilmember Mitchell absent.
ADJOURNED at 5:20 p.m.
Approved on this the 1st day of August, 1996, on, Mayor Pro Tern Garcia's motion,
Councilmember Goodman's second, 4-0 vote, Councilmembers Griffith, Mitchell and Slusher
temporarily absent.
